context: Tenant canvass at the hotel on 32nd (Act 3).

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Tenants' petition. The march is the twenty-third. Will you sign?

lines.speaker: npc.sro_resident
lines.text: Corwin? Never heard. Same owner as us? …Give me the pen.

lines.speaker: npc.sro_resident
lines.text: They emptied six floors here already. Six. Who's left to sign?

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Thank you. Bring a chair on the twenty-third.
